The '''Imperial Citadel''' was the structure the surviving [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] relocated to following the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. They were led there by the individual that would become the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]].

Within the Sith's first [[Standard century/Legends|century]] of their retreat to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] they constructed [[Kaas City]] deep in the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]], a testament to reestablishing the grand Imperial society lost in the Great Hyperspace War, and a mighty citadel in the center of the [[Kaas City|city]] which was known to house the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and his [[Dark Council]].

As the center of Imperial government, the citadel contained the headquarters of the Ministries of [[Ministry of War (Sith Empire)|War]], [[Ministry of Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Intelligence]], and [[Ministry of Logistics|Logistics]]. The citadel was also home to a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] embassy of sorts, known as the [[Mandalorian enclave]].

==Description==
[[File:GreatHyperspaceWarBasRelief-BotE.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Great Hyperspace War Bas-Relief in the Emperor's chambers.]]
In [[3678 BBY]], the [[Great Hyperspace War Bas-Relief]], or a similar rendering of it, was displayed along the wall of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] chambers.<ref name="The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith]]''</ref>

==History==
The Imperial Citadel on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] had two separate incarnations. The first one's construction began shortly after the [[Exile fleet]]'s arrival on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[4980 BBY]]. The original structure resembled both the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and the [[Sith Citadel (Ziost)|Sith Citadel]] on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]. Before it could be constructed, however, the land upon which the Citadel and Kaas City itself had to be [[Dromund Kaas wilderness campaign|cleared]] of not only thick jungle, but a host of fearsome creatures that made Dromund Kaas so dangerous. [[Odile Vaiken]], future father of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] and first [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the Empire, reportedly slew a rabid [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] on the site where the Citadel would later stand. It served as the seat of the Empire until it was destroyed in [[4043 BBY]] during the [[Kaggath (c. 4043 BBY)|Kaggath]] fought between [[Darth Qalar]] and [[Darth Victun]]. The two [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] were [[Death/Legends|executed]] by the [[Dark Council]], and [[Darth Nostrem]] was chosen to oversee the citadel's reconstruction.

The second citadel was designed by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] himself and differed greatly from the first. It was no longer modeled after the earlier citadel designs. After its construction, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Nostrem was locked in its depths in order to test the citadel's new labyrinthine defenses. The Sith Lord never escaped and eventually died.
